violation_type.title: Electronic CO Detection Sys Connected to Alarm/Smoke Detection Sys-Test Documentation Available During Hours of Operation (26 TAC §744.3757(b)(2))
violation_type.short_title: Electronic CO Detection Sys Connected to Alarm/Smoke Detection Sys-Test Documentation Available During Hours of Operation
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation did not have an inspection report for the electronic carbon monoxide detection system connected to an alarm/smoke detection system.

finding_variants.text: The operation did not have an inspection report for the electronic carbon monoxide detection system connected to an alarm/smoke detection system.
